login.heading: Sign in
login.lead: Use the passkey on this device to continue. There is no password to enter.
login.note2: No passkey yet? Ask the server owner for an invite link.

register.heading: Register a passkey
register.lead: This link works once. After the passkey is registered, the link stops working.
register.note1: Use the device you want to grant access to. The passkey stays on the device, not on the server.

signedIn.heading: Signed in
signedIn.lead: This browser has an active session. You can close the tab or sign out now.

invalidInvite.heading: Invite link is invalid
invalidInvite.lead: The link was used, revoked, or has expired. Ask the server owner for a new one.

granted.heading: Access granted
granted.lead: A guest session is active in this browser. Open the listed ports until the access period ends.

blocked.heading: This port is unavailable
blocked.lead: This port is not being forwarded right now. Contact the person who gave you the link if you need access.

denied.heading: This port is outside your access
denied.lead: This temporary access only covers specific ports. Ask for a new link if you need another port.

admin.title: Dashboard
admin.lead: Manage temporary access, passkeys, and forwarded ports.
admin.typeAccessHelp: The link grants temporary access to the chosen ports. It can be reused until revoked or expired.
admin.typePasskeyHelp: The link registers a new passkey for the owner account. Single use.
admin.label: Label
admin.maxHint: Maximum 12 months. There is no forever option.
admin.portsLead: Turn off ports that should not be forwarded.
admin.empty: No links yet. Create one from the panel above.
admin.errDuration: Duration must be between 1 minute and 12 months.

client.registered: Passkey registered. Redirecting to sign in...
client.unsupported: This browser does not support passkeys.
client.lib: The passkey library failed to load. Reload this page.
client.canceled: The request was cancelled or timed out. Try again.
client.security: This address does not match the registered passkey.
client.already: This passkey is already registered on the device.
client.network: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
client.invalidLink: The invite link is not valid.

api.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again shortly.
api.inviteInvalid: The invite link is invalid or has expired.
api.challengeInvalid: The verification session is invalid or has expired. Try again.
api.originDenied: The request origin is not allowed.
api.invalidDuration: Duration must be between 1 minute and 12 months.
